name: CPIC (Clinical Pharmacogenetics Implementation Consortium)
scope: Gene-drug guidelines, allele function tables and diplotype-phenotype translations.
mapping_methods: Allele definitions refer to reference sequences; coordinate mapping to be done via PharmVar/ClinPGx.

licence.name: The CPIC licence URL resolves to the ClinPGx data-use text (CC BY-SA 4.0)
licence.note: The licence page content was identical (same size) to the ClinPGx page; confirm CPIC-specific terms before redistribution.

coverage_limitations: Limited to genes with CPIC guidelines
known_omissions: Endpoints beyond gene and guideline lists were not explored

reuse_decision.rationale: Small API tables; combine with ClinPGx and PharmVar.

evidence_profile.biological_context: Gene-drug pairs with guidelines. Function is assigned to named alleles (star alleles) and diplotypes are translated to phenotype categories; categories are specific to the gene and to the drug in the guideline.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: Expert-curated allele function and guideline recommendations with CPIC's own evidence levels; assertions derived from published studies, not measurements of a given sample's alleles.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: Moderate at the haplotype level for well-studied alleles: function belongs to the haplotype and is not shown separately for each variant. Low for variants outside the allele definition tables, structural alleles and unresolved phase.
evidence_profile.phenotype_implication: Predicted metaboliser or transporter phenotype and a prescribing recommendation for a diplotype; drug-specific, not general.
evidence_profile.absence_means: An allele missing from the definition tables has unassigned function, which is different from normal function. A sample with no defining variant detected defaults to the reference allele by convention, an assumption about untested positions.

overlaps_with_sources.note: both describe star-allele definitions of the same genes; compare definitions, never sum counts
